verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google's spend produced zero results this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 133 leads at a cost of $19.24 per lead — every one of them came through Meta. Google Ads consumed $1,145 over the same window and produced zero leads, so that budget is being addressed directly. On Meta, lead volume dipped 41% in the most recent 7 days alongside a cost-per-lead increase of about 13%; the pattern points to uneven daily budget delivery rather than audience fatigue, and pacing is being corrected. Dedicated landing pages and new creative are on track to go live by August 31, which should stabilise Meta's delivery and give Google a proper foundation to work from when it is reactivated against real conversion signals. The pipeline also shows 133 leads received with no appointments booked, so intake and follow-up are being reviewed alongside the ad work.
